## What changed

Describe the claim, citation, governance, or site change.

## Evidence and rationale

Link the originating Discussion and provide DOI, PMID, or another stable source where applicable.

## Safety and review

- [ ] No PHI, identifiers, restricted data, credentials, private paths, or unpublished sensitive results are included.
- [ ] Existing claim IDs were not deleted or renumbered.
- [ ] Race/self-reported ancestry language avoids unsupported intrinsic or causal interpretation.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] A human reviewer still needs to approve scientific content before merge.
